units.source_text: 可是，这种时候发火，只会乱了自己的方寸。

en.t: But losing his temper at a time like this would only throw him off balance.

units.source_text: 一个重病人，不会为区区一张报纸而大动肝火的。

en.t: A seriously ill man would not fly into a rage over a mere newspaper.
He really did want to read a newspaper.

units.source_text: 没有风景，至少也想看看风景画吧，这也是人之常情嘛。

en.t: If there was no scenery, it was only human to want at least to look at a landscape painting.

units.source_text: 他曾经在哪一本书上读到过：

en.t: He had once read somewhere in a book that:

units.source_text: 风景画在自然风景欠佳的地方畅销，

en.t: landscape paintings sold well in places where the natural scenery was poor,

units.source_text: 报业在人际关系稀薄的产业地带发达。

en.t: and the newspaper business flourished in industrial districts where human ties were thin.

units.source_text: 而且，正巧碰上的话，报纸上还会刊登寻人广告。

en.t: And if the timing happened to be right, the paper might even carry a notice looking for a missing person.

units.source_text: 运气再好一点的话，说不定还会被写成“失踪启事”，装饰在社会版的一角。

en.t: With a little more luck, it might even be written up as a missing-person notice, decorating one corner of the society page.

units.source_text: 村里的家伙们，大概不会轻易将载有这种启事的报纸递过来吧。

en.t: The people in the village probably would not readily hand him a newspaper carrying that kind of notice.

units.source_text: 反正，现在最要紧的是忍耐。

en.t: In any case, the most important thing now was patience.
